application: row_window applies to Relation row occurrences; window_events applies to Events occurrences. Retain the checked Carrier, actual input occurrence, count dependency and governing law. Equal numeric bounds do not permit substituting another producer or Carrier.
options: Resolve size, any supplied step and offset under their declared millisecond domains before applying the bound. Size and supplied step are positive safe integers; offset is a signed safe integer. Duration Parameters use their admitted millisecond value. Missing bindings or invalid values remain failures even when an option does not change the multiplier.
fixed: The multiplier is 1. An explicit step is validated and retained but does not participate in boundaries, memberships or the bound. An omitted step is not inserted.
sliding: Step is required. The multiplier is ceil(size / step), computed exactly as quotient plus one when the remainder is nonzero. Closed-open membership and the offset grid imply at most this many memberships per input occurrence, including when step exceeds size.
bound: Multiply the applicable input occurrence upper bound by the multiplier using exact nonnegative safe-integer arithmetic. Reject overflow without rounding or saturation. Unknown input bounds are not zero. A zero input bound gives zero memberships but does not waive option validation.
identity_and_order: Offset is not reduced modulo the grid for identity. Retain authored options and Parameter dependencies. Membership occurrences preserve input logical order then ascending window start; this bound neither establishes input order nor proves ID uniqueness or window-role evidence after a later projection.
conditionality: The bound is conditional on operation success. Boundary arithmetic, input value validation and resource enforcement remain required. It does not prove acquisition completeness, authorize execution or permit truncation.
